pages.title: World and story
pages.markdown:
# Setting
A quiet island village whose lighthouse went dark. Ships no longer come, and the forest behind the village has grown wild.

## Main character
- Name: Ari
- Goal: relight the lighthouse
- Special: can talk to animals

## Places
- Village (start, shop, NPCs)
- Forest (first enemies)
- Lighthouse dungeon (boss)

## Quest line
- [ ] Talk to the old keeper
- [ ] Find the lens in the forest
- [ ] Defeat the Gloom in the lighthouse

pages.title: Characters
pages.markdown:
## Old keeper
Gives the first quest. Friendly, a bit forgetful, knows every story of the island.

## Shopkeeper
Sells potions and a better sword. Trades shells for coins.

## The Gloom (boss)
A shadow that hides from light. The player learns to lure it into lamp light, where it can be hit.
